mainText: Hello, Verona! At 12 AM, here is today's balanced dish: we are seeing clear skies and 72-degree temperatures near the Military Ridge State Trail. The moon is in its Third Quarter, and we have an exciting opportunity to spot the International Space Station at 4:19 AM tonight, as it glides from the northwest near the high school toward the east over Fitchburg, climbing about halfway up the sky.

The city has officially unveiled the Tai Chi Animal Frolics tree at Century School Park. This beautiful, seven-foot sculpture, carved from a reclaimed ash tree by local artists, depicts animals in traditional Tai Chi poses and is located near Art House 360.

There is plenty to do, including Yoga at Insight Wellness today and Hop Haus Trivia also happening today. Looking ahead, you can catch live music tomorrow at Bailey's Run Vineyard and the Wisconsin Brewing Company.

For our weekly report, on August 30, officers responded to the 800 block of North Edge Trail where a man intentionally smashed a vehicle window. The suspect, who was on probation, fled the scene, and a warrant has been issued for his arrest.
If you are craving a sweet treat, Culver's is currently closed but will be ready to serve you when they open today at 10:00 AM featuring today's flavor of the day.
